messages:
Riley: Quick sync: sketching a "sentinel gatekeeper" pattern for canaries. Idea: lightweight local sentinels enforce short-lived bailouts, a central gatekeeper mints promotion tokens and keeps the global truth. Goals: fast mitigation, bounded split-brain, per-tenant policy enforcement.

Amir: Love the split of responsibilities. Two questions: what is the sentinel scope (per-host, per-pod, per-request) and how long can they act without gatekeeper confirmation?

Zoe: Propose per-pod sentinel that can take action for up to 20s. Actions: divert to tenant pinned variant, reduce traffic, or route to cache. Anything longer requires a gate token.

deploy-bot: deploy 3654321000: canary "v8-slim" -> 0.5% at 15:07 UTC. Observability hooks attached.

Amir: Need a clear fallback precedence: 1) exact prefix cache hit 2) tenant-pinned variant 3) quantized local variant 4) external hosted fallback. Each fallback action must include a reason_code and tenant tag.

Riley: Agreed. Also add a micro-shadow stream (0.1%) to warm KV and trigger kernel warmups; mirror should be non-quota and skip long-running gens.

Zoe: Telemetry contract: every sentinel decision emits {tenant, sentinel_id, variant_from, variant_to, reason_code, signal_vector}. Keep sample_output_hash for drift. Do not include raw outputs.

Amir: For split-brain: if gatekeeper unreachable, sentinels enter DEGRADED mode: reduce allowed spill_pct by 10x, disable promotions to STABLE, continue short bailouts. Gatekeeper reconciliation will reconcile leases when reconnected.

Riley: State machine sketch: INIT -> SHADOW -> CANARY -> RAMP -> STABLE. Emergency transitions: any -> ROLLBACK or EMERGENCY_SPILL. Sentinels can trigger EMERGENCY_SPILL locally and request a persisted gate token; gatekeeper either confirms and records or issues rollback if global signals disagree.

Zoe: Add cooldown/hysteresis: after a sentinel-triggered spill, block promotions for N minutes and require two consecutive successful audit tokens before resuming ramp. Prevents flip-flop.

Amir: Ops runbook snippet: EMERGENCY_SPILL -> pause rollout, scale down variant to 0, route affected tenants to pinned variants, capture recent traces + cache snapshot, page oncall with tenant list and reason codes.

Riley: Tests: chaos job to kill gatekeeper mid-rollout, simulate noisy-tenant floods, and cold-cache cases where shadowing fails. Also automated eval replay every 10m against curated prompts to detect silent quality regressions.

Zoe: Action items: Amir -> telemetry schema; Riley -> state table + transition thresholds; I'll prototype sentinel lease logic and mirror filter.

Riley: I'll draft the RFC follow-up and include a short section on per-tenant policy schema. Ping if you want to co-author. Thanks :thumbsup:
